title: Rights and Responsibilities: Fairness at Work and in Society
text: Explore how your rights are protected in the workplace, the responsibilities you hold, and how to respond appropriately to unfair treatment.
cdi_links: 4.B.06 Understanding rights, responsibilities, and fair treatment in the workplace

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: How workplace rights are protected
The responsibilities employees must follow
How to respond appropriately to unfair treatment

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can explain how workplace rights are protected in the UK
I can identify key responsibilities employees must follow
I can describe appropriate ways to challenge unfair treatment

title: Key Words
bullets: Advocacy – Speaking up for yourself or others in a fair and appropriate way
Employment Law – Rules that protect workers and employers in the workplace
Diversity – Including people from different backgrounds and experiences

title: Starter Questions
text: What rights do you think employees should have in the workplace?
Why is it important for workplaces to have rules and expectations?

title: Workplace Rights
bullets: Being paid at least the minimum wage
Working in safe conditions
Protection from discrimination
Access to rest breaks and paid holiday
Rights are supported by contracts, workplace policies, and HR
Serious issues can be escalated through formal systems

title: How Rights Are Protected
bullets: Employers must follow employment law
Companies have procedures for dealing with complaints
Employees can raise concerns formally
Serious disputes may be resolved through employment tribunals
Systems ensure fairness and accountability

title: Workplace Responsibilities
bullets: Following company rules and policies
Treating others with respect
Completing work to the expected standard
Following health and safety guidance
A positive workplace depends on both rights and responsibilities

title: Speaking Up and Challenging Unfairness
bullets: Speak calmly to a manager
Use a formal complaints process
Seek advice or support
Access external services if needed
Professional communication increases chances of a fair outcome

title: Key Takeaways
text: Rights protect individuals from unfair treatment
Understanding your rights builds confidence and independence
Challenging unfairness appropriately supports positive change
